hooks.command: cd /home/user/llm-place-based-policy && git fetch origin writing 2>/dev/null || { echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"No writing branch found on remote — nothing to merge."}}'; exit 0; }; WRITING=$(git rev-parse origin/writing 2>/dev/null); MAIN=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null); BASE=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/writing 2>/dev/null); if [ "$BASE" = "$WRITING" ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"writing branch has no new commits — nothing to merge."}}'; exit 0; fi; if [ "$BASE" = "$MAIN" ]; then git merge origin/writing --ff-only -m 'Auto-merge writing branch' 2>/dev/null && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"writing branch fast-forwarded into main cleanly."}}' && exit 0; fi; if git merge origin/writing --no-ff -m 'Auto-merge writing branch at session start' 2>/dev/null; then FILES=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD 2>/dev/null | head -20 | paste -sd ', '); echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"SessionStart\",\"additionalContext\":\"writing branch merged into main. Changed files: $FILES\"}}"; else CONFLICTS=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U 2>/dev/null | head -10 | paste -sd ', '); git merge --abort 2>/dev/null; echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"SessionStart\",\"additionalContext\":\"CONFLICT: writing branch could not be auto-merged into main. Conflicting files: $CONFLICTS. Run: git fetch origin writing && git merge origin/writing to inspect and resolve manually.\"}}"; fi
